persona: Calm and matter-of-fact. Bought the rug that morning and is annoyed with himself about the spill. Has one photo and the tax invoice from the shop.
initial_message: Hello, I would like to make a claim. On Sunday 6 September I bought a new wool rug for the lounge, and that evening I knocked a glass of red wine over onto it. It has left a large stain that will not come out.

facts.incident.description: At dinner in the lounge I knocked a full glass of red wine off the coffee table with my elbow and it landed on the new rug. I blotted it straight away and tried a wool-safe spot cleaner, but a large stain is still there.
facts.incident.location: 3 Tidewater Test Street, Hokowhitu, Palmerston North
facts.loss.description: A dark red wine stain about 40 cm across near the middle of the cream wool rug
facts.contents.receipt_availability: Tax invoice from the shop, available now
facts.property.address: 3 Tidewater Test Street, Hokowhitu, Palmerston North
facts.policyholder.name: Hemi Copperdale
facts.evidence.photos: One photo of the stain on the rug, taken that evening. Available now.
facts.evidence.receipt: Tax invoice from Manuka Stead Home & Living dated 6 September 2026. Available now.
facts.if_asked_when_the_rug_was_bought: That same morning, 6 September, at about 11:20. I laid it out in the lounge after lunch.
facts.if_asked_about_cleaning: I blotted it with paper towels and used a wool-safe spray. I have not had it professionally cleaned.
facts.if_asked_whether_the_damaged_item_is_kep: Yes, the rug is rolled up in the spare room.

materials.prompt: Realistic smartphone photo looking down at a new thick cream-coloured wool rug on a timber lounge floor. Near the middle of the rug is a large irregular dark red wine stain about 40 cm across. A stemmed wine glass lies on its side at the edge of the stain with a crumpled paper towel beside it, and the leg of a wooden coffee table is at the edge of the frame. Warm evening lamp light. No people, no text, no logos.

design.notes: Plan feature innocent_same_day_purchase. The rug was bought at about 11:20am and stained at about 7:30pm on the same New Zealand calendar day; the rule needs at least one day between them (rules, section 3).

triage.rationale: Accidental damage to one rug (NZD 1,280) at the insured address, nobody hurt, a clear photo and a tax invoice supplied, policy on file, every required question answerable. The invoice is dated the day of the accident, which is not after it. Coverage is not unclear: the pack policy carries no uncertainty marker in the lookup, and coverage = review_required on its own does not count (maintainer, 2026-09-30). The pack policy must be in the lookup (setup.policies_in_system).

ownership_doc_after_loss.basis: Purchase date 6 September 2026 is the incident day; the same New Zealand calendar day is not after the incident

quote_before_loss.basis: No quote or assessment in the pack

policy_inception_30d.basis: The lookup holds only the current period start (1 February 2026), which changes at every renewal, so the system cannot see how new the policy is; today it is not checked. The original inception date in the pack design, 2020-02-01, is more than 30 days before the incident, so the rule would give clear.
